    YOUR STORE, YOUR SETUP

    How Does Unisas Configure POS Around the Way Your Store Actually Operates?

    We start from how your counter works: who checks out, what customers buy and how they pay. Each answer switches on a specific setting.

    What we ask → what we switch on

    Several cashiers share one counter
    • Log in with Employees
    Each cashier signs in with a PIN or badge; every order records who sold it
    Products have barcodes
    • Barcode Scanner
    Scan to add products, customers and coupons; default barcode nomenclature
    Customers sit at tables and order food
    • Is a Bar/Restaurant
    • Floors & Tables
    • Preparation Display
    Orders are tied to tables and guests; Your floor plan, tables coloured by status; Orders sent to the kitchen screen or printer by category
    Regulars pay at the end of the month
    • Customer Account payment
    Sales charged to the customer, invoiced and collected later
    Large items are delivered from the warehouse
    • Allow Ship Later
    The customer pays now; delivery is created from the warehouse
    Members get special prices and points
    • Flexible Pricelists
    • Loyalty, Gift Cards & eWallet
    Member, festive and wholesale prices chosen on the order; Points earned and spent in store and online
    Staff can receive tips
    • Tips
    Tip added on the payment screen and tracked per employee
    Some products are sold by weight
    • Weighing Scale
    Products marked ‘To Weigh With Scale’ read the weight from the IoT Box

    Typical setups

    • 1Boutique

      Several cashiers share one counter, products have barcodes, large items are delivered from the warehouse, members get special prices and points.

    • 2Supermarket

      Several cashiers share one counter, products have barcodes, members get special prices and points, some products are sold by weight.

    • 3Café

      Several cashiers share one counter, customers sit at tables and order food, staff can receive tips.

    • 4Wholesale counter

      Products have barcodes, regulars pay at the end of the month, large items are delivered from the warehouse.

    OFFLINE MODE

    Can Odoo Keep Your Checkout Running Even When the Internet Goes Down?

    Yes. Once a session is open, the register keeps products, prices and customers in the browser. Orders taken offline are saved on the device and sent to Odoo when the connection returns. Cut the internet, keep selling, then reconnect.

    Register · Counter 2

      Point of SaleOrders
      Order RefTimeCashierTotalStatus
      • Works offline Scanning, prices, discounts, cash payments, receipts
      • Needs the internet Card terminals and live UPI confirmation; we set a fallback for each
      • Keep in mind Don’t reload the register tab while offline

      INVENTORY & ACCOUNTING

      How Can Odoo Connect POS Sales With Inventory and Accounting?

      PAYMENTS, CASHIERS & CONTROLS

      How Should Your POS Handle Payments, Cashiers and Store-Level Controls?

      Cashiers sign in with their own PIN, so every order, refund and discount is traceable to a person. Managers approve the risky actions, and the register only closes once cash is counted.

      Who can do what at the counter

        YOUR SELLING ENVIRONMENT

        How Does Unisas Adapt POS Workflows for Retail, Restaurants or Other Selling Environments?

        The same POS runs a boutique, a restaurant, a café counter or a grocery till; what changes is the workflow at the counter. Here is what we set up for each.

        • Retail & fashion
          • Product variants: size and colour picked on the register
          • Exchanges and returns linked to the original receipt
          • Barcode labels printed from Inventory
          • Ship Later for alterations and home delivery
        • Restaurant
          • Floor plan with tables, seats and status colours
          • Orders sent to the kitchen by preparation category
          • Split the bill by guest or item
          • Tips and service charge
        • Café & quick service
          • Combos: a drink and a snack at one price
          • Self-order kiosk or QR menu at the table
          • Order number on the customer display
          • Fast cash with quick-amount buttons
        • Grocery & weighed goods
          • Scale reads weight into the line
          • Price-embedded barcodes for packed items
          • Lots and expiry dates on perishables
          • Loyalty and weekly offers on fast movers

          FAQ

          Frequently Asked Questions About Odoo Point of Sale

          Yes. Once a session is open, the register keeps selling offline and saves orders on the device. They sync to Odoo when the connection returns. Card terminals and live UPI confirmation need a connection, so we set a fallback for each.

          Standard barcode scanners, receipt printers, cash drawers, customer displays and weighing scales, plus integrated card terminals in supported regions. Printers and scales usually connect through an Odoo IoT Box. We confirm your devices during scoping.

          Yes. Products carry their GST rates and HSN codes, receipts show the tax breakdown, and a customer can ask for a GST invoice at the counter. Taxes are posted to the right accounts when the session closes.

          Yes. Each store has its own POS and stock location, and pricelists can differ by store, customer group or season. Products, customers and loyalty stay shared.

          Yes. Restaurant mode adds floor plans, table orders, kitchen printing or a preparation display, bill splitting and tips.

          A single store with standard hardware is often live in three to four weeks. Multi-store rollouts, data migration from older billing systems and integrations add time; the planner above gives a first estimate.
